test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

The documents have been signed by the director.

options.text: The director has been signing the documents.
The director has signed the documents.
The director is signing the documents.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Passive to Active Conversion:** To convert a sentence, the object of the passive sentence (the agent) becomes the subject of the active sentence.
 
• The original sentence is in the **Present Perfect Tense** (passive voice: *have been + past participle*).
 
• In the active voice, the Present Perfect structure must be: **Subject + has/have + Past Participle**.
 
• **Step-by-step conversion:** 
 
 
• Identify the agent: "the director" (becomes the new subject).
 
• Identify the verb tense: "have been signed" (Present Perfect).
 
• Identify the recipient: "the documents" (becomes the new object).
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The director has signed the documents."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The director has been signing the documents." – This is the **Present Perfect Continuous** tense, which implies an ongoing action.
 
• **Option 3:** "The director is signing the documents." – This is the **Present Continuous** tense, indicating the action is happening right now.
 
• **Option 4:** "The director signed the documents." – This is the **Simple Past** tense, which does not match the Present Perfect aspect of the original sentence.
